entries.zh: 灶口（灶的灶门、烧火添柴的开口）
entries.en: the mouth of a kitchen stove, the stoke-hole where firewood is fed in
entries.notes: M 栏作「chàu chǔy.?.chàu-caù」有脱字，R「chām quèn」不合「灶口」之音，四栏不齐，据汉字立义。

entries.zh: 灶嘴（灶的灶口、灶门）；西语词头 cocina 本义为厨房
entries.en: stove mouth, the opening of a cooking stove; (headword sense) kitchen

entries.zh: （食物）煮得烂熟、煮透；西语原义为分开单煮、另锅另煮
entries.en: cooked soft, boiled to a pulp; (Sp.) cooked separately, on its own
entries.notes: H「有爛」与 L「cocido aparte y aparte」语义不合，M 栏自注 [疑]，R「guièn tān」疑为「滾燙」之对音，释义存疑。

entries.en: cook, kitchen steward who prepares the meals
head cook, mess leader in charge of a group's cooking

entries.zh: 火长仔（小厨子、厨下帮手）
entries.en: assistant cook, kitchen boy (diminutive of 'head cook')
entries.notes: M「tāu ià」与 R「tēn chày」互不对应，据「仔」字之小称义推定为从属的厨役。

entries.zh: 馆夫（馆舍、官邸的仆役，此指官员的厨子）
entries.en: attendant of an official residence or hostel; here the Mandarin's cook
tide; the rising of the sea
the water rises; the tide comes in, the water swells

entries.zh: 筑（建造、增建房舍；房屋日日扩建）
entries.en: to build; to add on to a house so that it grows larger day by day
entries.notes: L 自注 [疑:casa/cica]、M 自注 [疑:Fioc/Tioc]，且 M 与 R「chō」不谐，据「築」字立义。

entries.zh: 诚（诚信、诚实；dar crédito 即给予信任、相信）
entries.en: sincerity, honesty, good faith; to give credit, to believe
entries.notes: M 栏自注 [疑:feng/seng]，当以「seng」为正；R「chèng」正合作「誠」。

entries.zh: 谅（相信、信任；受人信任、有信用）
entries.en: to trust, to believe; to enjoy trust, to have credit

entries.zh: 凭（凭据、凭证；可信的依据）
entries.en: proof, evidence; grounds for trust, credit
entries.notes: M 作「pīn sīn」疑为「憑信」二字连读，R 止一字「pèng」，故按凭据、凭信义释。

entries.en: to trust in, to rely on; to believe
sincerity; to believe, to be convinced

entries.zh: 孚心（衷心笃信、心里信服）
entries.en: to believe firmly in one's heart; heartfelt conviction

entries.zh: 孚契（信任友人、与友相契）
entries.en: to believe a friend; to trust an intimate or sworn friend
entries.notes: 「契」按契友、契合义解，与西语 creer al amigo「信朋友」相合，然 M 栏入声尾「quiy」可疑。
